verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fragments of guided setup. There is a step-by-step guide for one use case, generating and registering SSH keys on the key with OpenSSH. Yubico Authenticator is described as an intuitive GUI, but only for checking firmware, and ykman is a configuration CLI rather than an account-registration walkthrough. A community report says novices can enroll keys without a PIN 'if you didn't come across the right guidance', which suggests guidance is not well surfaced. Missing for 10: a documented setup app or wizard that walks users through registering the key with their online accounts, first-time onboarding instructions for end users, and hands-on corroboration that setup is guided.
